verdict.rationale: Working Copy ships its own AI Repository Agent on iOS that can browse, search, read and modify files in a repository, so an agent can review code and change it from the phone. Nothing in the evidence ties the agent to pull requests: no PR diff analysis or review-comment suggestions are documented, and the AI commit-message feature is a different capability. Missing for 10: documented agent analysis of pull requests or PR diffs, explicit code-improvement suggestion or review output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent analyze my pull requests and suggest code improvements from my phone

citations.quote: Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.
Code Agent & commit suggestions. Respects your data with opt-in.
